description: This file contains API functions for fetching user-related data, including user projects and basic user info, from a backend service. It defines two exported async functions: getUserProjects and getUserBasic.

methods.name: getUserProjects
methods.description: Fetches a user's projects from session tracking using the backend endpoint, with support for tenant ID and date range parameters.

methods.name: getUserBasic
methods.description: Fetches minimal user info by MongoDB ObjectId, handling 404 errors gracefully.
